--------------------------------------------------------- USER STORY ---------------------------------------------------------
Feature Promo Code / Discount Coupon
Objective
Allow logged-in users to apply a promo code on the Cart page to receive a discount before checkout.
--------------------------------------------------------- FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS ---------------------------------------------------------
1. Cart Page UI
- Display a Promo Code text field prominently near the Order Summary. - Display an Apply button beside the text field. - Promo code field is optional. - Checkout must work even when no promo code is entered. - Display the applied promo code after successful application. - Display a Remove link beside the applied promo code.
---------------------------------------------------------
2. Promo Code Field Validation
The Promo Code field should:
- Accept only alphanumeric characters. - Maximum length: 20 characters. - Trim leading/trailing spaces before sending to backend. - Show validation if Apply is clicked with an empty field. - Validate only when Apply button is clicked.
---------------------------------------------------------
3. Promo Code Validation
When Apply is clicked:
Call backend API.
Backend validates:
- Promo code exists. - Promo code is active. - Promo code is within valid start and end dates. - Only one promo code is allowed per cart. - Minimum order amount is met (if configured).
Minimum order amount is optional for every promo code.
---------------------------------------------------------
4. Error Messages
Display backend messages exactly as received.
Invalid code
"This promo code is not valid."
Already applied
"A promo code is already applied. Remove it before adding a new one."
Minimum order amount not met
"This code requires a minimum cart value of ₹X."
---------------------------------------------------------
5. Discount Types
Support two discount types.
PERCENTAGE
Example
SAVE10
10% discount on cart subtotal.
FIXED
Example
FLAT200
₹200 discount on cart subtotal.
Example rule
FLAT200 applies only when minimum cart value ₹2000 is met.
---------------------------------------------------------
6. One Promo Code Per Cart
If one promo code is already applied:
- Do not allow another promo code. - Display
"A promo code is already applied. Remove it before adding a new one."
Customer must remove the current promo code before applying another.
---------------------------------------------------------
7. Cart Summary
After successful application:
- Refresh cart from backend. - Display Discount as a separate line item. - Label format
Discount — Code (FLAT200)
- Display discount amount as a negative value. Example
-₹200
- Display discount line in green. - Immediately display revised Order Total below the discount. - Show Remove link beside applied promo code.
---------------------------------------------------------
8. Remove Promo Code
Clicking Remove should
- Call backend Remove Promo Code API. - Refresh cart. - Remove discount line. - Restore original order total. - Allow another promo code to be applied.
---------------------------------------------------------
9. User Access
- Available only for logged-in users. - Guest checkout is out of scope.
---------------------------------------------------------
10. Order Persistence
When cart converts to order
Store:
- Applied promo code. - Discount type. - Discount value. - Discount amount. - Final discounted order total.
Customer Order History should display
- Promo code - Discount line item - Adjusted order total
Finance systems should be able to retrieve discount information from the order record.
--------------------------------------------------------- BACKEND APIs ---------------------------------------------------------
POST /cart/promocode/apply
Request
{ "promoCode": "SAVE10" }
Example Response
{ "success": true, "promoCode": "SAVE10", "discountType": "PERCENTAGE", "discountValue": 10, "discountAmount": 250, "cartSubtotal": 2500, "cartTotal": 2250 }
---------------------------------------------------------
POST /cart/promocode/remove
Response
{ "success": true }
--------------------------------------------------------- IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS ---------------------------------------------------------
- Use Reactive Forms. - Use Validators.required only when Apply button is clicked. - Use Validators.maxLength(20). - Validate alphanumeric input using Regex. - Trim spaces before API call. - Disable Apply button while API request is in progress. - Disable Remove button while remove request is in progress. - Display backend error messages exactly. - Refresh cart after Apply and Remove. - Keep all HTTP calls inside PromoCodeService. - Component should never call HttpClient directly. - Use Observables throughout. - Handle loading, success and error states. - Strongly type all request/response models. - Follow Angular 17 best practices. - Use Bootstrap 5 styling.
--------------------------------------------------------- EXPECTED OUTPUT ---------------------------------------------------------
Generate complete Angular implementation including
- promo-code.component.ts - promo-code.component.html - promo-code.component.scss - promo-code.service.ts - promo-code.model.ts - API request/response interfaces - Required Angular module imports - Routing updates (if required) - Example integration into existing Cart component - Bootstrap 5 responsive UI - Reactive Form validation - Loading indicators - Success/Error message placeholders - Proper comments explaining the implementation
The generated code should be complete, production-ready, and follow Angular 17 best practices.
